q: The communication complexity of the disjointness function DISJ_n (do sets x,y⊆[n] intersect?) satisfies R(DISJ_n) = Ω(n) because:
opts: The function is hard to compute sequentially
The information cost per coordinate is Ω(1) under the hard input distribution, and direct sum gives total cost Ω(n)
exp: Kalyanasundaram–Schnitger, Razborov: each coordinate of [n] contributes Ω(1) information cost under the hard (promise) distribution. By the direct sum theorem for information complexity, n independent coordinates give total information cost Ω(n).
